policy.why_it_was_missing: The rails were listed; the rule governing them was never written down. An implied rule is re-derived differently every time it is read.
policy.scope: This guard constrains THE AGENT's destination choices when moving value. It is NOT a defence against key compromise — an attacker holding the key signs directly and never calls this code. Against key theft the only defences are a small hot balance, file permissions, and nobody reading the file.
policy.enforcement: Any action naming a destination absent from 'rails' below is refused. Unknown is a refusal, never a permissive default.

statuses.WATCH: may be used, but flag it in the report
statuses.QUARANTINED: REFUSED until explicitly un-quarantined by Jordan
statuses.APPROVED_NOT_ARMED: REFUSED until Jordan arms it. Approved is not armed.

hard_rules: No perps: not listed, therefore refused
No new venue without a rail entry and an explicit decision
A rail approved for one TENANT is not approved for another (see tenants.json) - approve per tenant, never globally
The destination must be named, not pasted as a raw address at action time
